refined.oewn-01953883-a.label: positive
refined.oewn-01953883-a.tone: Praises taste without naming what it consists of - which is how it also flatters the speaker's own.

civilized.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
civilized.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Sets a bar and implies others fall below it - praise with a hierarchy inside it.

civilised.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
civilised.oewn-01954376-s.tone: The British spelling; the same compliment with the same hierarchy inside it.

cultivated.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
cultivated.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Praises the work, not the birth - it says the taste was acquired on purpose.

cultured.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
cultured.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Warmer and less effortful than cultivated; it suggests taste that was absorbed rather than studied.

genteel.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
genteel.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Refinement praised, but primly - the word can carry a faintly pitying edge, as in 'shabby-genteel'.

polite.oewn-01954376-s.label: positive
polite.oewn-01954376-s.tone: Not courtesy but cultivation - the refinement a whole circle credits itself with.

polite.oewn-00644180-a.label: positive
polite.oewn-00644180-a.tone: Praise for meeting the standard; it says nothing about warmth, and sometimes implies its absence.

couth.oewn-01954649-s.label: neutral
couth.oewn-01954649-s.tone: The joke is in the word itself - refinement praised with one eyebrow raised.

mincing.oewn-01954782-s.label: negative
mincing.oewn-01954782-s.tone: Mocks refinement as performance - the daintiness is put on.

niminy-piminy.oewn-01954782-s.label: negative
niminy-piminy.oewn-01954782-s.tone: Pure contempt - the invented, mincing sound does the sneering.

prim.oewn-01954782-s.label: negative
prim.oewn-01954782-s.tone: Disapproves gently: correct manners held so tightly they have become a fault.

twee.oewn-01954782-s.label: negative
twee.oewn-01954782-s.tone: British and withering - sweetness pushed past charm into embarrassment.

angry.oewn-00114629-a.label: negative
angry.oewn-00114629-a.tone: Reports the feeling without judging it; the mildest and least loaded word in the family.

aggravated.oewn-00115077-s.label: negative
aggravated.oewn-00115077-s.tone: Points at whoever caused it - the anger is presented as a reasonable response.

provoked.oewn-00115077-s.label: neutral
provoked.oewn-00115077-s.tone: Puts the blame on the other party outright: someone did this to them.

angered.oewn-00115265-s.label: negative
angered.oewn-00115265-s.tone: Formal and slightly distant, as though reported rather than witnessed.

enraged.oewn-00115265-s.label: negative
enraged.oewn-00115265-s.tone: The anger has taken the person over; it describes a state, not an opinion.

furious.oewn-00115265-s.label: negative
furious.oewn-00115265-s.tone: The everyday word for full anger - vivid, and still sympathetic to whoever feels it.

infuriated.oewn-00115265-s.label: negative
infuriated.oewn-00115265-s.tone: Like enraged, but it keeps the cause in view: something did this to them.

maddened.oewn-00115265-s.label: negative
maddened.oewn-00115265-s.tone: Borrows the language of madness; the anger is presented as beyond reason.

black.oewn-00115608-s.label: negative
black.oewn-00115608-s.tone: Of a mood rather than an outburst - settled, silent and unpleasant to be near.

choleric.oewn-00115732-s.label: negative
choleric.oewn-00115732-s.tone: Anger as a defining quality, whether of the person or of the outburst itself.

irascible.oewn-00115732-s.label: negative
irascible.oewn-00115732-s.tone: The formal word for a short fuse; it condemns a standing disposition.

hot_under_the_collar.oewn-00115905-s.label: negative
hot_under_the_collar.oewn-00115905-s.tone: Comic and deflating - it makes the anger look faintly ridiculous.

generous.oewn-01114727-a.label: positive
generous.oewn-01114727-a.tone: The plain, unqualified praise - it credits both the giving and the spirit behind it.

benevolent.oewn-01115023-s.label: positive
benevolent.oewn-01115023-s.tone: Praises the disposition rather than any particular gift.

freehearted.oewn-01115023-s.label: positive
freehearted.oewn-01115023-s.tone: Warm - the giving is presented as coming from feeling, not duty.

big.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
big.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Praise with a shrug - 'big of you' can be sincere or sarcastic.

bighearted.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
bighearted.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Entirely sincere - it praises the person, not the sum.

bounteous.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
bounteous.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Biblical in flavour - generosity on a grand scale.

bountiful.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
bountiful.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Abundance more than kindness - the giving is a matter of plenty.

freehanded.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
freehanded.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Describes the habit of giving easily, with no comment on why.

handsome.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
handsome.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Praises the scale of the giving, and implies it exceeded what was owed.

giving.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
giving.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Slightly therapeutic in register; it names a personality type rather than an act.

liberal.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
liberal.oewn-01115129-s.tone: Abundance framed as generosity - the giving is ample rather than measured.

openhanded.oewn-01115129-s.label: positive
openhanded.oewn-01115129-s.tone: A vivid old word: the hand is not closed, and neither is the person.

stubborn.oewn-02334687-a.label: negative
stubborn.oewn-02334687-a.tone: Refusal held past the point of reason - the word faults the persistence.

obstinate.oewn-02334687-a.label: negative
obstinate.oewn-02334687-a.tone: Colder and more formal than stubborn; it withholds the affection stubborn allows.

unregenerate.oewn-02334687-a.label: negative
unregenerate.oewn-02334687-a.tone: The refusal is a refusal to be reformed, and the speaker has given up on it.

bloody-minded.oewn-02335070-s.label: negative
bloody-minded.oewn-02335070-s.tone: British and furious - it says the obstruction is the whole point.

cantankerous.oewn-02335070-s.label: negative
cantankerous.oewn-02335070-s.tone: Almost fond, in the way one is fond of a difficult relative; the word is too comic to wound.

bolshy.oewn-02335307-s.label: negative
bolshy.oewn-02335307-s.tone: Frames the refusal as insubordination rather than character - mutinous, not merely difficult.

stroppy.oewn-02335307-s.label: negative
stroppy.oewn-02335307-s.tone: British; it makes the defiance sound adolescent, which is the insult.

bullheaded.oewn-02335420-s.label: negative
bullheaded.oewn-02335420-s.tone: Adds stupidity to the charge - not just unmoving but unable to see why it should move.

bullet-headed.oewn-02335420-s.label: negative
bullet-headed.oewn-02335420-s.tone: The same accusation with a harder image, and unkind about the head as well.

pigheaded.oewn-02335420-s.label: negative
pigheaded.oewn-02335420-s.tone: The most contemptuous of the stubborn words: obstinacy treated as stupidity.

dogged.oewn-02335561-s.label: positive
dogged.oewn-02335561-s.tone: The same refusal to yield, entirely admired - dogged is what stubborn is called when it wins.

dour.oewn-02335561-s.label: negative
dour.oewn-02335561-s.tone: Unyielding and unsmiling; it judges the manner as much as the will.

careless.oewn-00312461-a.label: negative
careless.oewn-00312461-a.tone: The plain accusation: attention was owed and not paid.

casual.oewn-00313032-s.label: negative
casual.oewn-00313032-s.tone: In this sense, attention that was never offered - the ease is the fault.

cursory.oewn-00313032-s.label: negative
cursory.oewn-00313032-s.tone: Formal and cool - it reports the shallowness without raising its voice.

passing.oewn-00313032-s.label: neutral
passing.oewn-00313032-s.tone: The mildest in the family - the inattention is admitted but hardly blamed.

perfunctory.oewn-00313032-s.label: negative
perfunctory.oewn-00313032-s.tone: The work was done to be seen to be done; it accuses the motive, not the skill.

superficial.oewn-00313032-s.label: negative
superficial.oewn-00313032-s.tone: Cuts twice - shallow work, with a shallow person implied behind it.

haphazard.oewn-00313416-s.label: negative
haphazard.oewn-00313416-s.tone: Blames the absence of a method rather than the absence of effort.

slapdash.oewn-00313416-s.label: negative
slapdash.oewn-00313416-s.tone: The sound of the word carries the speed; brisk contempt rather than anger.

slipshod.oewn-00313416-s.label: negative
slipshod.oewn-00313416-s.tone: Old and severe: it implies a standard has been abandoned, not merely missed.

sloppy.oewn-00313416-s.label: negative
sloppy.oewn-00313416-s.tone: The everyday version, mild enough to say to someone's face.

heedless.oewn-00313654-s.label: negative
heedless.oewn-00313654-s.tone: Warnings existed and were ignored; it presumes there was something to heed.

reckless.oewn-00313654-s.label: negative
reckless.oewn-00313654-s.tone: The gravest here - the unconcern is careless enough to imply danger.

idle.oewn-00295041-a.label: negative
idle.oewn-00295041-a.tone: Describes the state, not the person - machinery and money are idle too.

bone-idle.oewn-00295329-s.label: negative
bone-idle.oewn-00295329-s.tone: British and total: the laziness is presented as going all the way through.

bone-lazy.oewn-00295329-s.label: negative
bone-lazy.oewn-00295329-s.tone: The same accusation in the plainer word; no part of the person is exempted.

faineant.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
faineant.oewn-00295445-s.tone: A do-nothing word for a do-nothing; it condemns from a distance.

indolent.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
indolent.oewn-00295445-s.tone: The softest of the real accusations - it sounds almost like a temperament.

lazy.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
lazy.oewn-00295445-s.tone: The everyday charge, and a moral one: the work was there and was not done.

otiose.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
otiose.oewn-00295445-s.tone: Idleness stated with Latinate coolness - disinclination to effort, judged from a height.

slothful.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
slothful.oewn-00295445-s.tone: Names one of the seven deadly sins; the laziness is a fault of the soul.

work-shy.oewn-00295445-s.label: negative
work-shy.oewn-00295445-s.tone: Accusing - unwillingness to work treated as a character fault, not a circumstance.

lackadaisical.oewn-00295877-s.label: negative
lackadaisical.oewn-00295877-s.tone: Comic rather than damning; the failing is a lack of spirit, not of will.

leisured.oewn-00296101-s.label: positive
leisured.oewn-00296101-s.tone: Idleness admired - because it is assumed to have been paid for.

unengaged.oewn-00296373-s.label: neutral
unengaged.oewn-00296373-s.tone: Purely factual: not currently occupied, with no view taken on why.

mannerly.oewn-00644365-s.label: positive
mannerly.oewn-00644365-s.tone: Old-fashioned and slightly schoolroom - it praises training more than instinct.

well-mannered.oewn-00644365-s.label: positive
well-mannered.oewn-00644365-s.tone: Credits the upbringing; the compliment reaches past the person to whoever raised them.

courteous.oewn-00644482-s.label: positive
courteous.oewn-00644482-s.tone: Formal warmth, with a whiff of chivalry - it praises the manner as a kind of respect.

gracious.oewn-00644482-s.label: positive
gracious.oewn-00644482-s.tone: The warmest in the family - courtesy extended when it need not have been.

nice.oewn-00644482-s.label: positive
nice.oewn-00644482-s.tone: Praise so mild it can read as faint disappointment.

praise.oewn-00858506-v.label: positive
praise.oewn-00858506-v.tone: The plain word, and the honest one: approval expressed and meant.

troll.oewn-00829262-v.label: neutral
troll.oewn-00829262-v.tone: Archaic and hearty - praise sung out in a full round voice.

salute.oewn-00858952-v.label: positive
salute.oewn-00858952-v.tone: Borrows the gesture from the military; it praises formally and briefly, as an act of respect.

applaud.oewn-00861956-v.label: positive
applaud.oewn-00861956-v.tone: Public by nature - the praise is performed so that others see it given.

laud.oewn-00862284-v.label: positive
laud.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Ceremonial - it lifts the praise onto a formal, liturgical register.

extol.oewn-00862284-v.label: positive
extol.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Praise at length and without reservation - the enthusiasm is part of the meaning.

exalt.oewn-00862284-v.label: positive
exalt.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Raises the subject rather than merely approving of them; close to worship.

glorify.oewn-00862284-v.label: positive
glorify.oewn-00862284-v.tone: Praise raised toward worship - and it turns accusatory the moment the object does not deserve it.

proclaim.oewn-00862284-v.label: positive
proclaim.oewn-00862284-v.tone: About the volume, not the sincerity: praise announced rather than felt.

flatter.oewn-00881748-v.label: negative
flatter.oewn-00881748-v.tone: Praise with a purpose: the compliment is a means to something.

blandish.oewn-00881748-v.label: negative
blandish.oewn-00881748-v.tone: Flattery with coaxing added - the praise is a lever being worked.

eulogize.oewn-00882301-v.label: positive
eulogize.oewn-00882301-v.tone: Ceremonial praise, expected by the occasion, which discounts it slightly.

eulogise.oewn-00882301-v.label: positive
eulogise.oewn-00882301-v.tone: The British spelling of the same funeral-shaped praise.

compliment.oewn-00883182-v.label: positive
compliment.oewn-00883182-v.tone: Small, direct and social - one remark, given to a person's face.

knock.oewn-00828170-v.label: negative
knock.oewn-00828170-v.tone: Casual and dismissive; it implies the criticism is cheap and possibly unfair.

criticize.oewn-00828170-v.label: negative
criticize.oewn-00828170-v.tone: The neutral verb - it names the act without saying whether it was deserved.

criticise.oewn-00828170-v.label: negative
criticise.oewn-00828170-v.tone: The British spelling of the same neutral verb.

pick_apart.oewn-00828170-v.label: negative
pick_apart.oewn-00828170-v.tone: Methodical rather than angry: the thing is taken to pieces on purpose.

reprimand.oewn-00825330-v.label: negative
reprimand.oewn-00825330-v.tone: Official and procedural - it happens on a record, from someone with the standing to do it.

censure.oewn-00825330-v.label: negative
censure.oewn-00825330-v.tone: Formal condemnation by a body; the weight comes from the institution.

criminate.oewn-00825330-v.label: negative
criminate.oewn-00825330-v.tone: Legalistic - it frames the fault as very nearly a crime.

savage.oewn-00825488-v.label: negative
savage.oewn-00825488-v.tone: The metaphor is an animal attack - it says the criticism went past its target.

blast.oewn-00825488-v.label: negative
blast.oewn-00825488-v.tone: Headline language: loud, public and short, with no pretence of fairness.

pillory.oewn-00825488-v.label: negative
pillory.oewn-00825488-v.tone: Public humiliation, deliberately staged - the criticism is meant to be watched.

crucify.oewn-00825488-v.label: negative
crucify.oewn-00825488-v.tone: The most extreme word here, and it casts the target as a victim rather than a culprit.

admonish.oewn-00825727-v.label: negative
admonish.oewn-00825727-v.tone: Gentle and improving; the point is to correct, and the relationship survives it.

reprove.oewn-00825727-v.label: negative
reprove.oewn-00825727-v.tone: A mild, old-fashioned rebuke - correction rather than attack.

reproof.oewn-00825727-v.label: negative
reproof.oewn-00825727-v.tone: The same quiet correction as the noun - the fault is named without heat.

boast.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
boast.oewn-00884747-v.tone: The standard accusation: the speaker is impressed with themselves and has said so.

tout.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
tout.oewn-00884747-v.tone: The boasting is done on something's behalf rather than one's own.

swash.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
swash.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Archaic - it suggests noise and swagger rather than claims.

shoot_a_line.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
shoot_a_line.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Implies the boast is invented as well as unwelcome.

brag.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
brag.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Blunter and more childish than boast; the word itself is faintly playground.

gas.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
gas.oewn-00884747-v.tone: The boasting is empty and long-winded - the complaint is about the volume.

blow.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
blow.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Self-praise treated as hot air - the claim is loud and thin.

bluster.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
bluster.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Loud claims covering weakness; it implies the speaker will not back them up.

vaunt.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
vaunt.oewn-00884747-v.tone: Elevated and old; the boasting is grand enough to sound almost heroic.

gasconade.oewn-00884747-v.label: negative
gasconade.oewn-00884747-v.tone: A learned, ornamental word for showing off - the vocabulary preening along with the speaker.

puff.oewn-00798965-v.label: negative
puff.oewn-00798965-v.tone: Bluster as sound - the speech is loud air, scorn without substance.

gloat.oewn-00885156-v.label: negative
gloat.oewn-00885156-v.tone: The cruellest here - the pleasure depends on someone else having lost.

triumph.oewn-00885156-v.label: negative
triumph.oewn-00885156-v.tone: Nearly neutral, and the only word that lets the winning be the point rather than the gloating.

crow.oewn-00885156-v.label: negative
crow.oewn-00885156-v.tone: The image is a farmyard bird at dawn: loud, repetitive and pleased with itself.

look.oewn-02134989-v.label: neutral
look.oewn-02134989-v.tone: The neutral verb; everything else in the family adds a judgement to it.

stare.oewn-00033399-v.label: negative
stare.oewn-00033399-v.tone: Rude by default in English - the length of the look is what makes it an offence.

take_a_look.oewn-02136242-v.label: neutral
take_a_look.oewn-02136242-v.tone: Casual and brief, with no attitude attached.

have_a_look.oewn-02136242-v.label: neutral
have_a_look.oewn-02136242-v.tone: The British phrasing of the same brief, unloaded glance.

get_a_load.oewn-02136242-v.label: neutral
get_a_load.oewn-02136242-v.tone: An invitation to look and react - the judgement falls on the thing seen, not on the looking.

look_back.oewn-02136564-v.label: neutral
look_back.oewn-02136564-v.tone: Directional and plain, though the phrase carries a second, wistful life.

look_backward.oewn-02136564-v.label: neutral
look_backward.oewn-02136564-v.tone: The literal direction, with none of the wistfulness *look back* can carry.

look_away.oewn-02136728-v.label: neutral
look_away.oewn-02136728-v.tone: Neutral in form, but the turning away is itself the act.

look_around.oewn-02136885-v.label: neutral
look_around.oewn-02136885-v.tone: Surveying rather than fixing on anything; no judgement either way.

gaze.oewn-02137210-v.label: positive
gaze.oewn-02137210-v.tone: Long and absorbed - the word grants the looker something worth looking at.

regard.oewn-02137650-v.label: positive
regard.oewn-02137650-v.tone: Formal and considering; the eyes are doing the work of the mind.

consider.oewn-02137650-v.label: positive
consider.oewn-02137650-v.tone: The looking has become thinking - attention paid rather than merely directed.

watch.oewn-02154940-v.label: neutral
watch.oewn-02154940-v.tone: Sustained and purposeful, and neutral until context makes it protective or sinister.

ogle.oewn-02168498-v.label: negative
ogle.oewn-02168498-v.tone: Condemns the looker outright: the look is sexual, unwanted and obvious.

complain.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
complain.oewn-00909100-v.tone: The neutral verb - it records the act and leaves the merits open.

kick.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
kick.oewn-00909100-v.tone: Implies the objection is loud and probably futile.

plain.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
plain.oewn-00909100-v.tone: Archaic - the bare, unadorned verb for voicing discontent.

sound_off.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
sound_off.oewn-00909100-v.tone: The complaint is unasked-for and delivered at length.

quetch.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
quetch.oewn-00909100-v.tone: A grumbling word - the complaint voiced as habitual discontent.

kvetch.oewn-00909100-v.label: negative
kvetch.oewn-00909100-v.tone: Exasperated but half-affectionate - complaining treated as a known habit.

nag.oewn-00846620-v.label: negative
nag.oewn-00846620-v.tone: Repetition is the offence: the complaint is not wrong, only relentless.

peck.oewn-00846620-v.label: negative
peck.oewn-00846620-v.tone: Small, repeated and birdlike; it makes the complaint sound trivial by design.

hen-peck.oewn-00846620-v.label: negative
hen-peck.oewn-00846620-v.tone: Openly sexist: it casts a wife as the tormentor and a husband as her victim.

backbite.oewn-00909610-v.label: negative
backbite.oewn-00909610-v.tone: The complaint is made behind the person's back, which is the whole accusation.

bitch.oewn-00909610-v.label: negative
bitch.oewn-00909610-v.tone: Coarse - the word dismisses the meanness even as it names it.

whine.oewn-00909883-v.label: negative
whine.oewn-00909883-v.tone: Attacks the sound and the character together - it says the complaint is beneath answering.

grizzle.oewn-00909883-v.label: negative
grizzle.oewn-00909883-v.tone: British, and it makes the complaining sound wet and wearing.

yammer.oewn-00909883-v.label: negative
yammer.oewn-00909883-v.tone: The complaint as noise: continuous, and no longer being listened to.
